about: Dates and datetimes in SOQL: literal values in any offset, relative date literals (TODAY, LAST_N_DAYS:n…), and date literals against datetime fields.

cases.name: values/datetimes are returned in Salesforce's format, in UTC

steps.query: SELECT Kickoff__c, CreatedDate FROM Project__c WHERE Name = '{tag} P2'
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c = {date:-10}
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c >= {date:-10} ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c < {date:-10}
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c IN ({date:0}, {date:40}) ORDER BY Name

cases.name: values/datetimes compare with datetime values, in any offset

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Kickoff__c < 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Kickoff__c = 2021-06-15T14:00:00+02:00
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Kickoff__c = 2021-06-15T08:00:00-04:00
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Kickoff__c > 2022-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

cases.name: values/a date value against a datetime field is an error

steps.query: SELECT Id FROM Project__c WHERE Kickoff__c > {date:0}

cases.name: values/a datetime value against a date field is an error

SELECT Id FROM Project__c WHERE Start_Date__c = 2022-13-01

SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c > TODAY

SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c = NEXT_N_DAYS:60

SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c = N_DAYS_AGO:10

SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Start_Date__c = THIS_MONTH
